catalyst.name: To the Pain, Crimson Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Passively grants 20 Range.
Every 30 points of damage taken with the weapon readied grants a Stack of 'To the Pain'. Maximum of 10 Stacks. Stowing the weapon removes all Stacks.
Each Stack grants ? Handling and 2 Aim Assist, maxing out at ? Handling and 20 Aim Assist.
Self-damage and environmental damage do not count.
